Commentary.Commentary: So, 79 is the total West Indies are chasing. Shouldn't be a tough task given the kind of batting West Indies have. They will look to break their losing streak and start the tournament with a win. Let's see if the Thai bowlers can make this interesting. Join us for the run chase in a bit.

Anisa Mohammed is down for a quick chat with Nasser Hussain. Anisa says that there was good bounce in the wicket but feels that they have top-class spinners in the side and adds that they did their job. Tells that they had done some study about the Thai batters. Ends by saying that they simply want to win the game.

There was pace and bounce on the wicket and Chinelle Henry and Shamilia Connell removed the two openers quickly. And once the spinners came, run-scoring became difficult. All the 4 spinners who bowled, they were all economical and ended up with at least a wicket. Skipper Taylor came to bowl in the later phase of the innings and bagged a 3-fer.

Nattakan Chantam played a couple of delightful shots but fell soon. Nannapat Koncharoenkai, the keeper of the side hung on in the middle and did the scoring but did not get enough support from the others. Chaiwai looked good for her 13 and she along with Koncharoenkai added 35 runs between them. However, once the stand was broken, it was only a nosedive for them.

Playing in the World Cup is always a pressure game and if a team is featuring in the tournament for the first time, there will always be pressure and nerves. That is exactly what was visible in this Thailand team. Only two of their batters could enter into double figures and that is enough to describe the batting from them.

OUT! STUMPED! Thailand lose their ninth wicket off the last ball and THEY FINISH ON 78/9. It was a dismal performance from them. Taylor flights this one outside off, Laomi dances down the track and looks to lift it over  extra cover but fails to get any bat on it. Shemaine Campbelle, the keeper whips the bails off and the batter was nowhere in the picture.
FOUR! First boundary since the fifth over! Flighted ball on middle, Laomi paddle sweeps it to the fine leg region for a boundary.
Floated on middle, Padunglerd flicks it to long on for a single.
Loopy one on middle, Laomi plays it down to long on for a single.
Flatter one on off, Padunglerd punches it to cover and takes off for a single. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. Would have been out had she hit.
Floated on off, Laomi drives it to long on for a single.
Flighted on middle, Laomi looks to sweep but it takes the top edge and goes towards square leg. A single to end the over.
BEATEN! Flatter one outside off, Laomi looks to cut off the back foot but fails to get any bat on it.

OUT! RUN OUT! Not a very smart call from the two batters. There was never a couple there. Floated on middle, Liengprasert flicks it to deep square leg and calls her partner for a couple. Henry comes across and throws it to the keeper, who whips the bails off. Liengprasert was nowhere in the picture. The third umpire was not even required.
Suleeporn Laomi walks in at no. 10.
Ratanaporn Padunglerd is in now.

OUT! CAUGHT! What a catch from Lee-Ann Kirby! Floated on off, Koncharoenkai lifts it towards mid off where Kirby dives to her right and takes the catch. 7th wicket down and Koncharoenkai falls after playing a good knock.
Short on off, Liengprasert punches it to mid off for a single.
Full on middle, Koncharoenkai sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
Afy Fletcher is back on! 2-0-7-0 from her so far.
Floated on the pads, Liengprasert flicks it to the leg side.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Toosed up on middle, Liengprasert lifts it towards mid off and takes a single.
Flatter one outside off, Liengprasert punches it to cover.
Full delivery outside off, Koncharoenkai drives it to extra cover and takes off for a run. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but mises. Had she hit, Koncharoenkai was a goner.
BEATEN! Floated outside off, Koncharoenkai looks to defend but fails to get any bat on it.
Liengprasert cuts this flatter one to the off side.
Low full toss on the pads, Koncharoenkai flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
Full and on the pads, Liengprasert works it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Quick run! Full and outside off, Koncharoenkai drives it towards mid off. The fielder there fumbles and they get the single easily.
Shortish and around off, pushed towards mid-wicket.
Flaoted on middle and leg, slower through the air as well. Koncharoenkai looks to defend but gets hit on the pads.
Wongpaka Liengprasert is the new batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT! 6th wicket falls and Taylor gets her second wicket of the over. Brilliant bowling from the skipper. They are ruling the roost here. Short ball outside off. Kamchomphu moves inside her crease and then looks to cut but it goes uppishly towards short third man where Lee-Ann Kirby dives forward to take the catch.
Flatter one outside off, Kamchomphu cuts it to the point fielder.
On off, driven to the off side.
Floated on off, Kamchomphu pushes it to mid off.
Onnicha Kamchomphu walks in at no. 7.

OUT! DRAGGED ON! Skipper takes the skipper! Thailand have lost half their side now. Floated outside off, Tippoch goes on her knees to sweep but gets an inside onto the stumps. Will Thailand reach 100? Does not look like it.
Full on middle, Koncharoenkai comes down the pitch and then flicks it to long on for a single.
WIDE! Flatter one outside off, left alone.
Stafanie Tayloe is on now.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

DROPPED! Stafanie Taylor drops a sitter! It should have been taken at this level! Floated on middle, Koncharoenkai comes down the track and looks to flick but it goes straight to Taylor at mid-wicket. She makes a complete mess of it.
Flatter one on off, Tippoch punches it to point for a single.
Floated on middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Full on middle, Tippoch works it to square leg.
Sornnarin Tippoch, the skipper, joins Nannapat Koncharoenkai.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Coming around the wicket does the trick! Matthews tosses this one on middle. Sutthiruang looks to drag it to the leg side but it goes straight into the hands of the bowler. Matthews makes no mistake and Thailand keep on crumbling. Even getting to 100 looks unlikely.
Tossed up ball on middle, Sutthiruang flicks it to square leg for a single.
Floated on off, defended to cover.
Floated on off, sutthiruang pushes it to mid off.
Loopy delivery on off, Sutthiruang looks to drive but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Short ball outside off, Koncharoenkai punches it to deep cover for a single.
Flatter one on middle, Koncharoenkai flicks it to deep square leg. The keeper chases after it but cannot stop the batters from taking a couple.
Loopy one on middle, Koncharoenkai flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Sutthiruang drives it to deep cover for a single.
Flighted on middle, Koncharoenkai sweeps it to the leg side for a single. 50 up for Thailand.
On off, defended to the point region.

An appeal for LBW turned down! Full one on the pads, Koncharoenkai looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. The Windies players appeal but the umpire is unmoved. They think of a review but decide against it.
Full on middle, Koncharoenkai pushes it back to the bowler.
Floated on off, Sutthiruang pushes it to cover for nothing. 4 and a wicket from the over.
On middle, Koncharoenkai plays it to long on for a single.
Flatter one on middle, Sutthiruang flicks it to the mid-wicket region for a single.
Full on middle, pushed down to long on for a single.
Chanida Sutthiruang walks in next, replacing Chaiwai.

OUT! CAUGHT! West Indies get their third. They are way on top in this game. They are not giving any runs and are taking wickets at regular intervals. Flighted fuller ball outside off, Chaiwai looks to lift it over mid off but does not time it well. It goes way up in the air towards mid off. Aaliyah Alleyne settles herself and takes the catch.
Short ball outside off, Koncharoenkai punches it to the deep cover region for a single.
Flighted ball on middle, Chaiwai sweeps it to mid-wicket. Only 4 from the over.
Full on off, Chaiwai looks to dig it out but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Comes around the wicket and bowls a full one on middle, Koncharoenkai flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
Flatter one outside off, Koncharoenkai cuts it towards third man for a couple. The fielder chases after it and cleans it up.
Floated outside off, Chaiwai drags it to long off for a single.
Full delivery outside off, Chaiwai lunges forward and drives it to mid off.
Hayley Matthews into the attack.
Flatter one on off, Koncharoenkai plays it to mid off. Only 2 from the over. 41/2 at the halfway mark.
Loopy one on middle, played back to the bowler.
Short ball outside off, Chaiwai punches it to deep cover for a single.
Chaiwai defends this floated ball outside off to the cover.
Flatter one on middle, Koncharoenkai works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Short ball outside off, Koncharoenkai punches it to the off side.
The batsman plays the square cut. One run added to the total.
Flighted ball on off, Koncharoenkai looks to defend but gets hit on the pads. An appeal for LBW is made but the umpire is unmoved.
Flatter one on off, Koncharoenkai pushes it to the cover region.
Floated on middle, Koncharoenkai defends it off the front foot.
Wide! Full down the leg side, Koncharoenkai looks to sweep but misses.
Tossed up on middle, Koncharoenkai plays it to mid on for a dot ball.
On middle, pushed down to long on for a single.
Floated on off, Koncharoenkai looks to punch but it takes the outside edge and goes towards third man. Dottin chases after it and cleans it up. Two taken.
Fullish on off, Koncharoenkai pushes it to mid off.
Loopy delivery on middle, Chaiwai flicks it uppishly towards mid-wicket. It lands safely and the batters take a single.
High full toss on middle, Koncharoenkai pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Full on off, Chaiwai pushes it down to long on for a single.
Short ball outside off, Chaiwai cuts it straight to point.
Anisha Mohammed is on now.
Fuller and outside off, Chaiwai sweeps it firmly to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller and around off, Koncharoenkai eases it down to long on for a run.
Fuller and around off, Chaiwai works it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller and around off, pushed to mid on.
Huge appeal for LBW but not out says the umpire. No review from West Indies. Flaoted one middle and leg, Chaiwai looks to defend but misses to get struck on the pads.
Fletcher with a shortish ball outside off, Koncharoenkai forces it towards covers and gets to the other end.
Afy Fletcher to bowl now. 1 slip in place.
On middle, punched through cover for a single. 27/2 after the Powerplay!
Short ball on middle, Koncharoenkai pulls it but straight to mid-wicket.
Fullish on middle, Chaiwai pushes it to mid on and takes a single.
Good length ball on middle, Chaiwai looks to defend but it takes the inside edge and hits the pads.
WIDE! Short of a length ball down the leg side, Chaiwai looks to pull but misses. Wide signaled.
On a length on off, Chaiwai punches it to the point fielder.
Full delivery on middle, Chaiwai looks to flick but it takes the inside edge and goes onto hit the pads.
Length ball outside off, Chaiwai pushes it towards cover-point and takes a run. Good over for Thailand, 12 runs from it.
Just a single of the Free Hit! Good length ball on off, Koncharoenkai looks to heave it away but does not time it well. It lands behind the mid off fielder and the batters only take a single.
FOUR! NO BALL! Blasted away for four! It is bowled above the waist and Koncharoenkai hammers it towards the deep mid-wicket region for a boundary. A Free Hit coming up.
Fuller and around off, Koncharoenkai flicks it towards deep mid-wicket and bags a couple.
Shortish and on the body, Chaiwai works it wide of the short fine leg fielder for a single.
Appeal for LBW but it is turned down! Length ball on the pads, Chaiwai looks to defend but misses to get hit on the pads.
Mislfield! Full ball on the pads, Chaiwai flicks it towards short fine leg where Fletcher misfields and allows a couple of runs.
Very full on off, Koncharoenkai pushes it to the cover region.
BEATEN! What a ball! On a length on off, angling in, Koncharoenkai looks to defend but the ball sneaks between the bat and pad. The ball goes into the mitts of the keeper.
Top edge but safe! On a length on middle, Chaiwai looks to flick but gets a top edge and goes towards third man. A single taken.
BEATEN! Good length ball outside off, Chaiwai looks to cut but the ball whizzes past the outside edge of the bat and goes into the mitts of the keeper.
Naruemol Chaiwai joins Koncharoenkai in the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT! Second one falls in no time and Thailand are struggling here. Chantam has to go. Played two delightful shots before this but has to go now. Good length ball outside off, Chantam looks to defend but gets an outside edge back to the keeper. Campbelle the keeper, pouches it easily and West Indies are on top on this fast pitch.
FOUR! Hammered! Full outside off, Chantam prods forward and drives it through the cover region for a boundary.
Swing and a miss! Very full delivery outside off, Koncharoenkai looks to drive but misses it altogether. No runs and a wicket from the over, super stuff from Henry.
Good length ball on middle, Koncharoenkai defends it out onto the pitch.
On a length on middle, Koncharoenkai pushes it back to the bowler.
Full on middle, Koncharoenkai flicks it to mid on.
Nannapat Koncharoenkai is the new batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Boochatham falls and West Indies get an early breakthrough. Good length ball outside off, Boochatham looks to punch but it goes off uppishly towards point. Deandra Dottin takes an easy catch at point.
Just short! Good length ball on off, Boochatham looks to defend but it goes uppishly. Luckily, for her, it lands in front of the bowler.
Play and a miss! Back of a length outside off, Chantam looks to cut but fails to get any bat on it.
FOUR! Shot! What a way to get the first boundary. Fullish delivery outside off, Chantam leans forward and drives it through the cover region for a boundary.
Play and a miss! Short of a length outside off, Chantam looks to cut off the back foot but fails to get any bat on it.
Good length delivery on middle, Boochatham flicks it to mid-wicket and takes a single.
On a length on middle, Boochatham flicks it to the leg side.
Fullish outside off, Boochatham pushes it straight to the mid off fielder.
Shamilia Connell to bowl from the other end.
BEATEN! On a length outside off, Chantam looks to push it off the back foot but fails to get any bat on it. Good first over for West Indies.
BEATEN! Beautiful delivery! Good length ball outside off, Chantam looks to defend off the front foot but fails to get any bat on it.
On a length outside off, Chantam looks to defend at first but removes the bat at the last moment. The ball goes to the keeper.
Good length ball down the leg side, Boochatham flicks it to fine leg for a single.
Full on middle, Boochatham flicks it to mid on where the fielder tumbles to make the stop.
Thailand are underway! Henry starts with a short ball outside off, Chantam punches it to deep cover to get off the mark.

We are all set to begin! Nattakan Chantam and Nattaya Boochatham make their way out to the middle as the openers for Thailand. The Windies players follow them out. Chinelle Henry will start with the ball for the Windies.
National Anthem - Both sides make their way out to stand in respect of their respective National Anthems.

Pitch report - Nasser Hussain says that it is one of the quickest surfaces in the world. Tells that it is going to be difficult for the batters to score freely. Feels that the quicker bowlers will get a  lot of support from the pitch.

West Indies Playing XI -  Hayley Matthews, Lee-Ann Kirby, Stafanie Taylor (c), Deandra Dottin, Shemaine Campbelle (wk), Chedean Nation, Chinelle Henry, Aaliyah Alleyne, Anisa Mohammed, Afy Fletcher, Shamilia Connell.

Thailand Playing XI - Nattakan Chantam, Nattaya Boochatham, Nannapat Koncharoenkai (wk), Naruemol Chaiwai, Chanida Sutthiruang, Sornnarin Tippoch (c), Wongpaka Liengprasert, Onnicha Kamchomphu, Ratanaporn Padunglerd, Suleeporn Laomi, Soraya Lateh.

Stafanie Taylor, the West Indies skipper, says that she was looking to bowl first anyway. On the tournament and their recent form, Taylor says that there have been a few ups and downs in the past. Says that they had a warm-up game against India which was good practice for them. Finishes by saying that they will look to restrict the Thai team under 100.

Sornnarin Tippoch, the Thailand skipper, says that the team is confident about their batting. On their recent form and build up to this game, Tippoch states that they are confident of playing at the big stage. Tells that the side is ready to play their hearts out. Says that they will try to do their best in the all departments and would also play hard cricket.
Toss -  Time for the spin of the coin. Heads is the call from the Thai skipper and it lands as heads. Thailand have won the toss and they choose to bat.

Hello and a warm welcome to the second match of the ICC Women's T20 World Cup. Thailand, the first-timers in the World Cup arena are coming here after some good performances. They would look to start the tournament with an upset over the Windies. Their opening pair had a good 2019 and will be hoping to continue that form. West Indies, on the other hand, come into this tournament in poor form. They have lost nine matches on the trot. They would want to make a good start to the tournament. Who will come out on top? Will it be the newcomers or will the Windies start the tournament with a win? Toss and team updates in a while.
